calendar_data_freeze.build_input_policy: download hash-pinned JPL and USNO inputs locally; do not commit source snapshots
calendar_data_freeze.runtime_implementation: project-authored JavaScript lookup and traditional mapping
calendar_data_freeze.event_time_definition: TT minus the frozen Delta T model, encoded as Unix milliseconds for a UT1-as-UTC comparison proxy; not unqualified exact historical UTC
calendar_data_freeze.lunar_edge_policy: accept only a unique nominal label that converts inside 1901-01-01 through 2033-12-31

combined_guard_freeze_gate.method: test the Cartesian product of new-moon and major-term alternative Beijing dates under their own event guards
combined_guard_freeze_gate.failure_policy: abort generation if any combination changes major-term month membership; explicit alternate month sequences would then be required before release
combined_guard_freeze_gate.frozen_result: major-term membership and the leap-month sequence remain unique under the combined guards; date-level uncertainty remains encoded

runtime_boundary_semantics.solar_term_jie_guard: one guarded Jie expands to before/after calendar_model_variant responses with source_case_id and solar_term_boundary_uncertainty
runtime_boundary_semantics.gregorian_lunar_boundary: return the nominal fixed-UTC+8 lunar value with boundary_uncertainty; unresolved_result_change_without_enumerated_variant prohibits treating the lunar label as unique
runtime_boundary_semantics.lunar_reverse_conversion: fail closed only when the requested label is affected by an event model-guard crossing or explicit historical calendar-authority divergence; review-only events remain convertible

uncertainty_layers.meaning: User-configured sensitivity/review band around chart boundaries.
uncertainty_layers.not: Not a calendar-data error estimate, confidence interval, or probability distribution.

uncertainty_layers.meaning: Conservative event-level guard for the frozen Delta T/time-scale model.
uncertainty_layers.segment_storage: Every encoded event stores both its resulting guard and a Delta T source code.

segments.note: Conservative historical calendar-construction/model guard and review band; not a claim of 600-second error for all dates.
Small numerical/time-scale guard applied per event.

segments.policy: ceiling of the published prediction error plus 2 seconds
segments.note: Uses the frozen published error column; not an empirical confidence interval.
Post-2033.75 context-only engineering scenario, not an official prediction or confidence interval.

uncertainty_layers.source: local comparison to HKO publication tables
uncertainty_layers.meaning: A date/convention disagreement between the frozen retrospective astronomical model and a publication-table authority.
uncertainty_layers.not: Not interchangeable with either the user boundary guard or the dataset event model guard; no HKO row is substituted into release data.
